title: cordiera elliptica
intro: Cordiera elliptica, commonly known as Ipecacuanha, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family, native to the tropical forests of Central and South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. Therapeutically, Cordiera elliptica is known for its emetic and expectorant actions, which help stimulate digestion and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of Cordiera elliptica include alkaloids, such as emetine and cephaeline, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
